postprocess_config.anchor_rule: one distinct numeric C coordinate within radius; conflicting coordinates leave free corner fixed
postprocess_config.degenerate_rule: free only: exact repeated coordinate or exactly zero FP64 cross product
postprocess_config.duplicate_rule: free only: same three numeric coordinates ignoring winding; C wins, then first retained free source face
postprocess_config.free_rule: lexicographic original-point representatives; nearest existing representative within radius; no transitive unions or means
postprocess_config.known_vertex_identity: FP32 coordinate bytes, including signed zero
postprocess_config.normalization: NONE; never normalize the generated bbox
postprocess_config.radius_limit: Single engineering threshold; original paper runtime units are not fully traceable

RBF.weights: 1/source-ID corner multiplicity; all proposal copies retained

FEEDBACK.driving_error: Original C minus full D0 C proposal BEFORE restoration
FEEDBACK.working_C_corners: Independent corner deltas; internal query may split source copies
FEEDBACK.endpoint: Always query delta_2 and use that query free output; no best-iteration selection

protocol.auxiliary: Existing D3, three total D0 calls
protocol.selection: All12 fixed USER_MIX; no result-based filtering
protocol.PRE_metrics: Full existing threshold matching, distances, exact-coordinate topology; full PRE quality NA_NOT_BUDGETED
protocol.POST_metrics: Existing full quality and matching, valid edges/winding/reachable area; GEO fates
protocol.required_join_boundary: NA_NOT_REGISTERED; all C source open edges descriptive
protocol.synthetic: Four CPU geometry fixtures and three analytical feedback fixtures; no claim of real D0 synthetic recovery
protocol.stopping: Complete fixed panel, audit, report and small review ZIP; no default change/commit/scan
